name: Generate a runnable desktop data product from intent

checks.check: Read inferred_model.json and the supplied CSV headers before authoring.
Create spec.py, models.py, infra-profile.yaml, transform/main.py, requirements.txt, and a relative csv-source-path. Do not author deployment-spec.yaml, manifest.yaml, or models.yaml.
Do not alter supplied CSV headers or rows to manufacture a primary key.
Every promised physical base model declares one or more existing source columns with primary_key(); semantic views are exempt. Accept a validated composite key, but never synthesize a key.
Use public semantic_model/semantic_view/metric_field APIs. Base models own keys, dimensions, and joins; views own metrics. No private nxd.spec imports or __nxd_semantic__ metadata writes.
Promise physical models, register views with .model(...), use output port duckdb and no .semantic_tools() call.

Use dlt through DuckDbOutput, source only from secrets[csv_source], a read-back naming assertion over promised physical models only, run-local dlt state, replace writes, and .transform-complete. Do not ingest or expect semantic views from duckdb.model_tables.
Run check_generated_closure.py against the final closure and obtain ALL CHECKS PASSED.
Do not claim a supervisor build or governed semantic query when the evaluator only executed the transform.
